plot: Jin Taekyung receives a massive global welcome at Incheon, where hundreds of thousands cheer during a televised car parade that ultimately ends at Peace Guild's guild house. Surrounded by his family and Team Leader Choi, Taekyung resolves to protect those close to him, while he forces the sulking Skeleton King to join Peace Guild under a prepared contract. After Magic Johnson announces negotiations with Peace Guild, the public celebration continues into Christmas Eve, tormenting Go Jun, who rages at Taekyung's name before being interrupted by a cautious report.
